data.body: **[P1] Preserve the context that created an external reference.** This passes the consumer’s context to `load`. For a chained invoke, the target creates the envelope using its root-execution context, while the caller resolves it using the invoke operation’s context. Any offloader that keys or authorizes loads using `PayloadOffloadContext` therefore cannot read invoked results. Store the producer context in the envelope (or otherwise preserve it) and test a context-keyed offloader end to end through `invoke`.
